Blockers

Zero verified blockers in this scoped re-review.

P08 — closed. At src/crypto_trader/paper/session.py:174–178, run() materializes the complete observation sequence and rejects any symbol differing from config.symbol. This occurs before ledger initialization, journal reads, validity adaptation, engine startup, decisions or journal writes. Consequently, the original BTCUSDT-observation/ETHUSDT-session falsifying input now raises PaperStateError instead of silently relabeling the observation. Checking the entire sequence also prevents a later mismatched observation from allowing earlier side effects.

test_p08_symbol_binding.py:12–27 exercises mismatches at both indices of a two-observation tape and asserts an empty journal and absent temporal runtime.

P09 — closed. At src/crypto_trader/execution/nautilus/simulation.py:74–85, start_temporal() requires queue_aware is True and validates queue settings before constructing or starting the runtime. guard.py:73–78 requires both boolean settings to be exactly True and book_type to equal L2_MBP. TradingSession invokes this guard before entering its decision/journaling loop at session.py:245–246.

The original hold-only session with queue_aware=False therefore raises QueueAwareConfigurationError before engine or journal side effects. The new regression also exercises an L1_MBP downgrade. The batch simulate() opt-out remains available to Phase-4 callers, but an ordinary NautilusSimulationRunner injected into the supplied Paper session structurally selects the temporal path; that batch behavior does not reproduce the original bypass.

P10 inspection

At runtime.py:200–202, has_queued_orders() checks the actual request deque. At simulation.py:155–165, finish_temporal() drains remaining market events, then raises PaperStateError if requests remain queued, before engine end or a successful outcome. runtime.py:327–332 permits deque removal only on a market event strictly later than decision completion.

The supplied last-tick, after-last-tick and empty-native-tape inputs therefore retain the unsubmitted request and fail closed. Cleanup runs through simulation.py:166–168; session.py:341–343 also aborts unsuccessful temporal completion. No cancellation, retry or native submission evidence is fabricated.

The check deliberately differs from has_unsettled_orders(): an already submitted accepted or partially filled native order is not rejected merely for retaining evidenced leaves. That matches the stated P10 scope.

The changed causality regression still checks that the historical tape produces no fill. The changed risk-feedback regression retains the first durable fill and verifies that the second risk snapshot reflects prior execution before the final unsubmitted intent causes failure. These assertions preserve the substantive checks while updating the expected completion behavior.

Nonblockers and limitations

Native nonzero resume remains explicitly refused at session.py:240–243. ScriptedSimulationRunner remains a legacy test double and supplies no proof of native engine restoration.

The prior partial-fill-then-cancellation replay concern remains visible at report.py:259–266. An applicable native cancellation trace has not been supplied, so it remains an unresolved concern, not an additional verified blocker.

The supplied P10 regressions directly cover queued failure and fully filled success. They do not directly demonstrate accepted-unfilled or partially filled successful completion at the final horizon. This limits coverage confidence; it does not establish a falsifying input.

Deferred fixture improvements remain backlog, without waiver.

The supplied tree proof reports recomputation to the candidate tree with 322 entries. I did not independently recompute the tree, packet hashes or execution-to-tree binding. Thus the fixed-gate evidence reports zero scoped blockers, full pytest zero failures and a matching recomputed tree; this review does not independently certify provenance or issue final adjudication.

Requested reviewer label is gpt-6.1-sol. No provider-signed exact serving identity or Thinking designation is established here. Separate Sol adjudication remains outstanding; no final release approval is issued.
